purpose: Teach: ジョナサン/ジャカルタ/草津/マイアミ/ロースト/ニーチェ/のび太/ワトソン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジョナサンの聖書の話をされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told Aoi about his interest in the Bible.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Sharing something noticed rather than said directly. Soft, almost thoughtful pacing. The warmth of noticing what someone else might have missed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジャカルタに駐在経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned he was stationed in Jakarta.
lines.style: Quiet, conversational delivery. A small nod to a detail Aoi picked up during the shift. Warm but unforced. Natural recall without fanfare.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、草津温泉に毎年行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer said he goes to Kusatsu hot springs every year.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried pace. The tone of someone sharing a small piece of information that feels quiet and personal. A soft, almost wondering quality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マイアミでの留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has study abroad experience in Miami.
lines.style: Light, conversational. Sharing the detail with a sense of quiet interest. Warm delivery, like appreciating another person's world without making it dramatic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ローストビーフ料理がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's hobby is cooking roast beef.
lines.style: Observant, almost admiring softness. The tone of noticing something that reveals character. Unhurried pacing, genuine interest underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ニーチェの哲学にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer is quite knowledgeable about Nietzsche's philosophy.
lines.style: Quiet respect in the delivery. A light note of appreciation for intelligence or depth. Calm, steady pacing. The warmth of recognizing something thoughtful in another person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様がのび太そっくりだって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was laughing about how much his kid looks like Nobita.
lines.style: A small, genuine laugh underneath. Affectionate amusement at the customer's warmth and self-awareness. Light pace, warm without being loud. The shared moment of seeing someone else's tenderness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シャーロック・ホームズのワトソン役が好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer said he loves the Watson character in Sherlock Holmes.
lines.style: Reflective, quieter close. A detail that feels almost intimate—the choice revealing something about how he sees the world. Gentle pacing that trails softly at the end.
